items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: those guys were my idols for a long time, they still are, when I listen to them play now on records

ctx.x: Marky Markowitz, yeah, wonderful players. I mean those guys were my idols for a long time, they still are, when I listen to them play now on records, I can’t believe how good they were.
